description: Formant oscillator: a sine primary with four ringing formant oscillators mixed over it.

params.text: Switches the sync input between hard sync, which restarts the primary oscillator, and soft sync, which reverses its direction; the lamp is lit for soft.
Sets the pitch, four and a half octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz.
Scales the FM input marked GLOBAL, -100% to +100%, at 261.63Hz per volt at full; that modulation reaches the four formant oscillators and not the primary.
Scales the FM input marked PRIMARY, -100% to +100%, at 261.63Hz per volt at full; that modulation reaches the primary oscillator and the formants with it.
Crossfades the main output from the bare primary sine to the four formants mixed together.
Scales the CV for the mix or balance it belongs to, from -100% to +100%; 5V covers the whole range at full.
Crossfades the formant mix between the X pair and the Y pair.
Crossfades the X side of the formant mix between X1 and X2.
Crossfades the Y side of the formant mix between Y1 and Y2.
Sets that formant's frequency as a multiple of the primary, from 1 to 240 times.
Scales the CV for the formant setting it belongs to, from -100% to +100%.
Sets how long that formant's envelope takes to die away after each cycle of the primary; at 100% it lasts two cycles, and lower settings cut it shorter.
Sweeps that formant's ratio within each cycle of the primary: positive settings start the cycle high and fall back to the set ratio, negative settings start there and rise.
Switches that formant oscillator between a sine and a square.
Switches that formant oscillator between a sine and a sawtooth.

inputs.text: Pitch at a volt per octave, added to the frequency knob; the channels patched here set the polyphony.
Frequency modulation for the primary oscillator, scaled by the knob marked FM PRIMARY.
Frequency modulation for the four formant oscillators, scaled by the knob marked FM GLOBAL.
Syncs the primary oscillator, hard or soft as the SYNC button is set.
Moves the crossfade between the primary and the formants, scaled by the attenuverter for it.
Moves the balance it belongs to, scaled by the attenuverter for that balance.
Moves that formant's ratio, adding 48 to the multiple per volt at full attenuation.
Moves that formant's damping, scaled by the attenuverter for it; 5V covers the whole range at full.
Moves that formant's warp, scaled by the attenuverter for it; 5V covers the whole range at full.

outputs.text: The primary and the formants mixed as the controls are set, swinging between -5V and 5V.
The bare primary sine, swinging between -5V and 5V.
That formant oscillator on its own, without its envelope, swinging between -5V and 5V.
That formant's envelope, 0-10V, falling from full at the start of every primary cycle.

menu: Warp Range — how far WARP can bend a ratio, one of 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x or 32x; 4x until it is changed.
